summary: Switches between multiple input materials by index, with clamp, loop, or zigzag behavior for out-of-range and negative indices.

key_params.name: index
key_params.note: Input material index; first input is 0

key_params.name: extend
key_params.note: Clamp, loop, or zigzag out-of-range index behavior

key_params.name: dodeform
key_params.note: Enable deform handling on the switched material

key_concepts: Switch MAT chooses between multiple input materials using a zero-based Index parameter.
The Extend menu defines out-of-range behavior with clamp, loop, and zigzag modes, including behavior for negative indices.
Switch MAT is useful for look-dev and control-rig workflows where a CHOP or parameter selects between material variants.
Input order matters: index 0 is the first input, so generated networks should keep material inputs intentionally ordered and documented.
Common MAT render-state and deform pages still apply to the switch wrapper after the selected input is chosen.
common_gotchas: Index 0 selects the first input; CHOP-driven switches often need explicit rounding or limiting.
Loop and zigzag allow negative indices, which can be useful but surprising in control rigs.
Common MAT render-state pages still apply after the selected input is chosen.
